purpose: Run Claude Code with alternative models through OpenRouter, using LiteLLM as a proxy
routing: Claude Code normally calls the Anthropic API
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL redirects Claude Code to a compatible endpoint
LiteLLM receives requests in the Anthropic Messages format and sends them to OpenRouter
OpenRouter routes each request to the configured model
verification: Ask Claude Code a question and check that it responds
Open https://openrouter.ai/activity and verify the request, model, tokens, and cost
The /cost command in Claude Code displays $0.00 because the request did not use Anthropic billing
constraints: LiteLLM must remain running while Claude Code is in use
Do not include prices or comparative quality claims in the FAQ
